protocol.scope: Synthetic local two-tenant V1, HTTP API through PSA simulator; no inference under load
protocol.mix: Three context reads then one approved write; alternating tenants; alternating note/time writes
protocol.resources: API/simulator/test runner <=384 MiB and 1 CPU each; DB <=256 MiB and 1 CPU; no host ports
protocol.stop: Abort profile on first failed outcome; stop isolated stack on failure; never touch unrelated projects
protocol.limitations: Short desktop qualification, not sustained production soak or capacity certification. Real-provider timing and quality are separately recorded in Phase 6.

load.timing_note: Synchronous HTTP responses include processing. Execute includes downstream dispatch and read-back; not measured as a separate acknowledgement. Approval is synthetic, not human wait.

backup_restore.scope: consistent logical dump into separate disposable database; no loss of snapshot rows

resource_exhaustion.scope: isolated backend-image process, not actual model inference
